quotes.text:
This is a dummy file that isn't used.
Its only purpose is to have an irrelevant file that can
be modified whenever we need to trigger a new build,
but no other commits are pending.

NOTE: these commits pollute the commit history. Where possible try to avoid them.

Instructions:

If a new build for comm-central is desired, edit this file,
and make a change below the line.
(For example, add another dot, or remove one.)

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Both entries edit build/dummy to trigger builds without another pending landing. The file documents that purpose and recommends useful source/documentation landings when possible. These human edits are eligible infrastructure context rather than automated commits, but they do not provide a unique syntax rule or proof that a build ran successfully. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Human build-trigger edits are intentional infrastructure context
